SELECT r.business_date, r.units_sold rpt_units, r.net_sales_before_returns rpt_net, x.units_all, x.units_nonstaff, x.net_all, x.net_nonstaff
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) units_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) units_nonstaff, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) net_nonstaff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-30' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1) x ON x.sale_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=108 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY ALL
